# Native inventory cube geometry

`native.tsv` is generated by calling original `bb.a(sj,ji,int,int,int,int,int)`
with native `cv` and `uu` classes from the SHA-256-pinned client, for stone,
three log variants and three wool variants at GUI origin (10,20). Class hashes
are recorded in the header. Only `nw`, `ji`, and GL11 are substituted with
recorders. `nw` records the vertex and UV doubles as exact hexadecimal floating
point, face normals and draw boundaries; GL11 records transform and color
commands in native order. The actual client renderer selects textures and emits
all six quads. The stubs do not rasterize, apply matrices, compute lighting,
depth, normals, blending or sample textures; resulting pixels and final lit
colors require separate verification. A vertex's final color depends on GL
lighting and caller state, not merely recorded `glColor4f`.

The `ji` texture manager is stubbed and no local asset is read. `ViewOracle`
provides hash and source verification. Reproduce twice with
`python3 -m unittest tests.python.test_inventory_cube_oracle -v`; missing JAR
or Java is reported as a skipped audit, incorrect JAR or mismatch fails.
